name: CENNETIC 1160 Heavy-Cut Vertical Machining Center
summary: The 1160 is a heavy-cut vertical machining center for large steel parts and mold bases, with a stiff column and wide table.
body:
The 1160 is a heavy-cut vertical machining center for large steel parts and mold bases, with a stiff column and wide table.

Technical specifications

ItemUnitSpec

Screw bearing6setFAG/BSB
Ball screw3setHIWIN
Coupling3setJapan

System1setMitsubishi (Japan)
Motor4setMitsubishi (Japan)
Lubrication system1setHoval
Telescopic cover3setHongwang/Aipai'er

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
